articles.title: How technology is helping restaurants scale regional Indian cuisine while maintaining consistent taste
articles.summary: Regional Indian cuisine is witnessing a significant surge in popularity across the country, driven by restaurant chains expanding beyond their home cities. This trend introduces a broader national audience to diverse culinary traditions, from Chettinad curries and Malabar seafood to innovative millet-based dishes. It signifies a growing appreciation for India's rich gastronomic heritage, fostering cultural exchange and a more unified culinary identity nationwide.

articles.title: Malabar Group Chairman conferred Maharashtrian of the Year Award 2026 by Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis
articles.summary: MP Ahammad, Chairman of Malabar Group, has been honored with the prestigious Business Bhushan Award at the Lokmat Maharashtrian of the Year Awards 2026. This significant recognition celebrates his exemplary and visionary leadership, underscoring his substantial contributions to the Malabar Group's growth. Such accolades highlight influential figures in Indian business, reflecting strong leadership and strategic acumen vital for national economic progress.

articles.title: THE VAMPIRE LESTAT Opening Credits Sequence Released As AMC Announces Official Premiere Date
articles.summary: The third season of the popular series "Interview with the Vampire" is officially titled "The Vampire Lestat," echoing the second novel in Anne Rice's famed saga. Fans can anticipate the continuation of the dark, intricate narrative, as the "Devil's Road" appears to reach a significant juncture – possibly a conclusion or a new beginning for its captivating characters. This upcoming season promises further twists in the vampire epic.

articles.title: Congresswoman Charged with Stealing $5 Million in FEMA funds
articles.summary: A U.S. Congresswoman has been charged with allegedly stealing $5 million in funds from the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA). This serious accusation involves misuse of federal resources intended for disaster relief and highlights potential issues of corruption within political office. Such incidents underscore the importance of accountability and integrity among public servants in national governance, demanding scrutiny of financial oversight.

articles.title: Shlokas, self portraits and spirituality: How a Pune artist is navigating ideas of balance
articles.summary: Monalisa Kalagram currently exhibits a distinctive art installation: a large woman's head adorned with diving goggles, her hair suggesting an underwater float. The artwork integrates a shloka from the Bhagawad Gita, indicating a blend of artistic expression with spiritual or philosophical depth, engaging visitors with its unique visual and conceptual layers.

articles.title: AMC’s Anne Rice series The Vampire Lestat gets a June premiere date
articles.summary: More than a year and a half ago, AMC announced the renewal of its series 'Anne Rice's Interview with the Vampire' for a third season. A key development revealed then was that with this upcoming third season, the show is slated to transition or move to a new platform or format, referenced as 'the e…'. Further specifics about this change are expected as the release date approaches.

articles.title: Peter Bart: Oscar Week Brings Comforting Distraction From Hollywood’s Regime Changes & Very Risky Business
articles.summary: The author reflects on HBO's corporate journey over two decades, noting its transformation from an independent network to a corporate asset. After being acquired by AT&T, HBO subsequently came under Discovery's ownership. This succession of takeovers highlights significant consolidation and evolving ownership structures within the media industry, reshaping how major content platforms operate.

articles.title: IRN2Vec: A representation learning model for road network intersections by integrating geospatial attributes and travel behaviors
articles.summary: Urban computing research crucially depends on traffic data analysis to address city challenges effectively. The article emphasizes the deep analysis of intelligent transportation spatiotemporal data for developing advanced urban solutions. This research aims to optimize traffic management, reduce congestion, and enhance urban planning through data science, paving the way for more efficient and sustainable smart cities.
